faq.heading: Frequently Asked Question
faq.description: Frequently asked questions about GrowthLab services

items.question: How often do you need to repair your roof?
items.answer: Most roofs need minor repairs every 5–10 years and major repairs every 15–20 years. We recommend a yearly inspection, plus an extra check after heavy storms, so small issues get caught early.

items.question: Do you offer a next day delivery service?
items.answer: Yes, next-day delivery is available on most roofing materials within our service area for orders placed before 2:00 PM. Same-day delivery can also be arranged for urgent or emergency jobs.

items.question: What is the standard delivery time?
items.answer: Standard delivery takes 2–5 business days within our service area. Larger or custom orders may take 7–10 business days. You'll receive tracking details once your order is shipped.

items.question: How can I access emergency services?
items.answer: Our emergency roofing services are available 24/7 for leaks, storm damage, and urgent repairs. Just call our emergency hotline at [phone number], and a technician will be dispatched right away.

items.question: Do you offer an installation service?
items.answer: Yes, we offer full installation services for residential and commercial roofs. Our team manages everything from inspection and material selection to final installation, all backed by our warranty.
